title: Finding a Field in Joined Data
statement: Let $m>0$, let $\Gamma$ and $A$ be types, let $\delta:A\to\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)\to A$, and choose $a_0\in A$ and $acc:A\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Let $fs$ be a list of exactly $m$ nonempty finite lists over $\Gamma$, and let $d$ be a two-work-tape configuration on input $x$ in state $none$. Suppose the first work tape of $d$, at every offset from $-1$ through the length of the joined encoding of $fs$, agrees with that encoding. Then the find machine has a positive time $t\le 7(|joinFields(fs)|+1)$ at which it reaches the otherwise unchanged configuration except that the first work-tape head is advanced by $fieldOffset(fs,j)$, where $j=m-1$ if $acc$ accepts the fold of $\delta$ over the joined fields starting at $a_0$, and $j=m$ otherwise. At every time $u$ with $0<u<t$, its state is neither the initial read state nor the exit state; at time $t$ it is in the exit state if the fold is accepted, and otherwise in the initial read state.
hypotheses_covered: Types Γ and A, transition function δ, initial value a₀, and acceptance predicate acc
List fs has length m and every field is nonempty
Two-work-tape configuration d on input x starts in state none
First work tape agrees with the joined-field encoding at offsets −1 through its full length
replaced:
Let $m>0$, let $\Gamma$ and $A$ be types, let $\delta:A\to\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)\to A$,
choose $a_0\in A$ and an acceptance predicate
$acc:A\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $fs$ be a list of exactly $m$
nonempty finite lists over $\Gamma$. Let $d$ be a two-work-tape configuration on input
$x$ in state $none$, and suppose its first work tape agrees with the encoding of the
fields joined by blank separators at every offset from $-1$ through the full
joined-string length. Then the find machine reaches, after some positive number
$t\leq7(|joinFields(fs)|+1)$ of steps, a configuration with the same input, tape
contents, output, and other head position as $d$, with its first work-tape head advanced
by the sum of the lengths plus one of the first $j$ fields, where $j=m-1$ if $acc$
accepts the fold of $\delta$ over the joined fields starting from $a_0$, and $j=m$
otherwise. At every intermediate time $u$ with $0<u<t$, its state is neither the initial
read state nor the exit state; at time $t$ it is in the exit state when the fold is
accepted and otherwise back in the initial read state.
